notes.title: Version 1.0
notes.notes: Even though this game has been retired, I haven't forgotten about you!

notes.title: When I update the game you will no longer get corrupt save files
notes.notes: I think it's ideal to fix the save system this way now that the userbase has grown.

notes.title: Combat update
notes.notes: Just an update to combat. Chances are you'll miss sometimes if you button mash button "E". So make sure you're over your weapons energy. But you will no longer lose energy if you're under your weapons energy.

notes.title: Patch notes 19-10-09 15:15
notes.notes:
Fixed exp visuals.
Fixed item description visuals.

notes.title: Ruls whip update
notes.notes: When Ruls attacks with his whip, it causes him to get into an invulnerable state.

notes.title: We need to release the game now
notes.notes:
We have to release the game now from early access for various reasons. The game depends on it for survival.

New acts will be made, it depends on how well it does.

notes.title: Some quick fixes before release date
notes.notes: Attacks won't use up your energy if you don't move. When you don't move, you can't attack. We want the game to be fast paced, that is the reason behind the nullment of attacks if you don't move.
